hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); [Console]::InputEncoding = $utf8; $hookInput = @($input) -join [Environment]::NewLine; & (Join-Path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 'scripts/agent-workflow-runtime.ps1') codex guard -HookInput $hookInput; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
